A tank whose only OFFENSIVE lines are her burst nuke and (out-of-scope) boss stat-downs; the modeled surface is small by kit reality, not by omission. Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-08-04 — test-first re-derivation pinned by scripts/tests/units/ludmilla.test.ts (G0 sole-B1 fixture sanity, L5/L6 pins, L1-L4 absence guard + non-vacuous injection), cross-family S2b (claude-fable-5) / S5+S6 (claude-opus-5) / S7 (kimi-code/k3 binding judge) converged. SKILL1 ('Noblesse Oblige' — last bullet hits the target → the target): DEF ▼8.4%/10s is MODELED as lastBullet → enemy defPct -8.4 /10s on the enemy DEF channel (bossDefNow scales cfg.bossDef at damage time, floor 0; the trigger is the kit's own 'last bullet' clause — one proc per ~9.1s magazine cycle at 120 ammo / 20 shots/s + 187f reload, near-continuous uptime via same-caster-slot overwrite refresh, no stacking clause). ~8.4% of the scope-lock boss's 140 DEF ≈ 11.8 ATK — sub-0.1% at the graded basis, live at the web raid DEF defaults; NOT damageTakenPct (the spec's zero-damageTakenPct-anywhere guard pins that channel absent). ATK ▼8.4%/10s stays UNMODELED (inert ⚑1): the boss never attacks in the DPS sim AND applyEffect drops enemy ATK▼ (no incoming-damage model). The unit spec's non-vacuous guard injects the nearest-wrong S1 (boss Damage Taken ▲8.4%) and proves it WOULD move team totals, so the absence pin gates something. SKILL2 ('Queenly Disposition' — on entering Full Burst): BOTH lines UNMODELED (inert): the 15.09s all-enemy taunt has no threat/targeting model in v1 (the solo boss already attacks the team abstraction; trigger identity fullBurstEnter recorded so a future consumer never misfiles it as burstCast), and the self Damage Taken ▼57.86%/15s has no incoming-damage model to reduce (immortal boss — it is the SELF-targeted ▼ mirror of the boss damageTakenPct channel, never that channel; the spec's zero-damageTakenPct-anywhere guard pins the sign/channel misread). BURST ('Snow Queen', cd 20s): burstCast → enemy flatDamage 163.1 (the kit's '163.1% of final ATK' to 'the 10 enemy unit(s) with the highest final ATK' — target CAPACITY, not a hit multiplier: exactly ONE enemy exists at scope lock, so exactly one hit per cast; burst-cast damage lands BEFORE the Full Burst window opens, so it never takes the +50% FB major — verified fact 2026-07-13). PLUS burstCast → allies defPct 12.93 / 10s: 'DEF ▲12.93% for 10 sec' to all allies behind the 'when above 50% HP' gate — the gate is CONSTANT in v1 (no HP pool / incoming-damage model, every unit is always at full HP), so it is always-TRUE and modeled unconditionally (the soline Max-HP-gate documentation pattern: the gate is recorded, never enacted as a blocker); defPct is itself inert in v1 ('self DEF doesn't affect own damage'), so the line is pinned on its buffApply events alone (magnitude/scope/duration/cast-coupling), per the tandem rule that DEF/heal/shield lines are ENCODED as future-consumer feeds, not dropped. Burst gauge (0.15%/shot) is carried by the datamined burst_energy_pershot 1500, not an override block. No heal/shield/gauge/ammo/reload/weapon-swap/round-count lines in this kit; every duration is plain wall-clock seconds. Element: Water — clean ×1.10 advantage vs the Fire-attribute fixture boss. ⚑ FLAGS: (⚑1) S1 ATK▼ — inert on any v1 basis (boss never attacks); estimate = 0; recipe = none until an incoming-damage model exists. (⚑2) CADENCE TUPLE — SMG RoF 1440 + reloadFrames 187 shipped datamine as-is; estimate = engine-default SMG quantization; recipe = rounds/min + reload gap from any ludmilla focus video (the tuple also sets the S1 defPct proc cadence via the magazine cycle). (⚑3) MULTI-TARGET COLLAPSE — the 10-target burst clause collapses to one hit vs the solo boss; estimate = correct at scope lock, undercounts only in hypothetical multi-target content v1 does not simulate; recipe = n/a. (⚑4) HP-GATE REAL-GAME DIVERGENCE — the always-true gate may overstate DEF-buff uptime if a real ludmilla spends time below 50% HP; estimate = full uptime in the sim vs potentially lower in game; recipe = footage of the DEF-buff popup after she has taken heavy damage.
